notes.title: Major Souper Game Demo Update for Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
The game keeps evolving!
The gameplay is now even more fun and dynamic and the elf girl is sassier, chattier and still hot as always...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174630/e8e4e175e306baa0cd436e3c1542b2168048daa7.png[/img]

[b]Changelog:[/b]

[list]
[*] A story event with yoga. You will like it... ;)
[*] A story event with soap bubbles.
[*] The elf girl is now more talkative. Added comments after level completion, unique comforting lines for losses and some jokes with hints.
[*] A secret mini-boss...
[*] Three new soundtracks for story events.
[*] Encyclopedia button (just the button for now, without the actual encyclopedia).
[*] Control hints in the menu.
[*] New visual effects from dancing enemies.
[*] Three new items for the top fridge shelf. I'm sure you'll love them!
[*] Four new skins for the snail. She can finally change her home!
[*] Reworked ice cream mini-game. New mechanics — simpler, fairer and easier to understand.
[*] Completely updated English translation.
[*] Boss death animation improved.
[*] The bee has been fixed. It no longer dies from a closed lid, reclaiming its title as the most annoying enemy!
[*] New tutorial elements.
[*] Minor bug fixes and tweaks.
[/list]
The elf girl's comments between levels are still in test mode and your feedback is really important to us! ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174630/4425f666a27552c27c2b585e5e53510da5dc0f25.png[/img]

notes.title: Updated demo with Streamer Mode is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174630/37a60bc5696a33854465b99629d807943935e994.jpg[/img]
We are participating in the Igroprom competition, so we decided to release a demo with the updated gameplay, without new story scenes yet but with an optional Streamer Mode, so content creators can already stream the new demo.
The story-expanded demo will arrive within a month! 😄

What’s new:

1. Updated gameplay! It’s now less boring and much more varied.

2. A spicy new mini-game with the elf girl! Currently available from the start, though in the future it will unlock after defeating the boss.

3. New enemy tier! Scarab creeps, ninja bugs, and creepy-crawly bugchicks — all ready to ruin your day or eat you alive.

4. New items! Some are hilariously useless, others — incredibly valuable.

5. Auto-clicker added as a standalone skill in the upgrade tree.

6. Dialogues updated to be more coherent and funny.

7. Streamer Mode can now be enabled via settings or a separate screen at the start of the game.

8. Final demo screen includes spoilers for upcoming game events.

9. Teaser of the second boss.

10. New soundtrack specially composed for the intro.

11. New interactive zones, more easter eggs and fresh sound effects.

12. Three new skills to upgrade

13. random encounters and animations for them

14. Overall smoothness and convenience

notes.title: Souper Game Development News
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45174630/0fd6233c5d7916254554185fef1e84ff6f2599dc.png[/img]
Hello everyone! It’s been a month since the demo was released, and I’d like to share some development news.
Gameplay: We decided to change the balance a bit and shift the gameplay from a roguelike mechanic to a more arcade-style. And now players will progress through levels and upon death, you’ll only need to restart the current level rather than the entire gameplay.
The levels become longer and more diverse. New special types of enemies will appear sometimes. Rare items will also be introduced—both highly useful and harmful. These items are optional and sometimes it might be better to discard them ;)
We’ve added more variety by introducing three new items per tier. Currently, I made nine types of vegetables, fruits, and meats—not counting the special items with cool effects.
Story: We decided to reduce the number of story events from 18 to 15, but make them more engaging and diverse. At this moment 7 out of 15 story events have been drawn and scripted into the dialogues.
Based on feedback from polls, we learned that jokes about the Troll can include elements of dark humor. In some story actions we’re inspired by "Tom and Jerry" and I think some situations will really surprise you :)
Mini-games with Sylvie: I’ve drawn 3 out of 5 mini-games featuring the elf girl. And now we have:
- Lollipop;
- Ice cream;
- Whipped cream with strawberries.
Animations for them are still in progress.
That’s all now! Don’t miss more exciting news!
